**Analyzing the Pattern**

I've zeroed in on the alternating row structure within each colored rectangle. Row 0 remains solid, while Row 1 presents an alternating color-zero sequence, starting with the rectangle's color. This pattern holds true within the dataset so far, I believe the details will become clear with more information. In train 1, specifically, rectangle 1 is r.


**Confirming the Rule**

I've formalized the alternating pattern: within a rectangle, if (r - r_min) % 2 == 1 AND (c - c_min) % 2 == 1, then the cell's color is set to zero. Otherwise, it retains its original color. This rule holds across various train datasets and test inputs. I have now verified this.
